# primitives.lib

Documentation of the Faust primitives (`mem`, `rdtable`, `hslider`,
`select2`, `with`, `letrec`…) in the faust2md comment format, used by
the editor completion and hover (`faust-completion.js`).

Copied unmodified from FaustIDE (`grame-cncm/faustide`,
`src/monaco-faust/primitives.lib`, commit 901b780). It is a FAUST library
file, Copyright (C) 2003-2016 GRAME, under the LGPL 2.1 with the FAUST
library exception stated in its header — the same terms as the standard
Faust libraries bundled in `libfaust-wasm/`.
